title: SectionViewStyle hatch-angle cardinality overlay
scope: Support same-version SectionViewStyle group-40 hatch-angle vector growth and shrink
Keep source count/group cardinality consistency fail-closed and update the declared count on typed edits
Preserve the group-4 hatch-scale first-occurrence contract when adding angles
Verify raw carrier and typed round trips in ASCII and Binary DXF

implementation.summary: The SectionViewStyle overlay validates the source declared angle count against the raw group-40 angle occurrences, updates the group-90 total to the typed vector length, overlays retained values, erases trailing values on shrink, inserts new values in sequence on growth, enforces the 100000-value bound, and refuses non-finite angles. If a missing scale must precede newly serialized angles, it inserts the scale before group-4 transparency/count fields.
generatedControls: ASCII and Binary typed round trips for angle growth 2 to 3, shrink 2 to 1, and shrink 2 to 0; full ordered raw carriers and typed vectors are checked.
Generated source with missing scale and zero angles, then typed angle insertion; readback verifies scale, angle, count, and ordered raw carrier.
Non-finite typed angle refusal preserves an existing output sentinel.

validation.scopedDiffCheck: git diff --check passed for the plan, adapter, and focused adapter test

planImpact.next: Continue remaining PAR-138 typed/raw field cases and the broader plan; do not wait for external qualification.

limitations: This is same-version generated DXF writer evidence; it does not establish independent parser acceptance or native CAD behavior.
Hatch-angle API semantics and unresolved group-290 meanings are not inferred by this slice.
The worktree is broadly dirty; unrelated changes were preserved.
Git metadata is read-only, so no staging or commit was possible.
